text: It works as it should, design is interestingly chosen, but it fullfills everything that one could wish for in a habit tracking app. What i really like is that i can add notes to my habits daily. Tho could you please add Czech language as one of the options? I would really appreciate the option to have this app in my native language 😊
author: Zuzana Marešová
developer_reply:
Hello Zuzana,

Thanks for the review.
Prague is my favorite city in the world. I am a native English speaker and I might need your help with translation.
Can you please mail to contact@habityou.com
Have a wonderful day!

text: It's a good app but for that money I would like to see a little bit more

developer_reply:

Thanks for the review. We are adding a lot more this year. You will love it. For any help please mail to contact@habityou.com
